issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which conflicts with the specified constructor signature and may confuse students or cause tests that expect the UML order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Lecture constructor in the solution (and ensure the template guidance matches) so its parameter order matches the UML and problem statement: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign the fields accordingly. Alternatively, if a different order is intended, update the problem statement/UML to reflect the actual constructor signature.
